ENGLISH: The Egyptian government has sent us a proposal. They say that our defeat at the hands of Cappadocia has put us in a dangerous position, and that with their help we can turn the tide. They have offered help in gaining us control over all of Anatolia in return for us pledging ourselves to them, and becoming their pawn.

The Greek Terror has finally been defeated! After 6 long years of war we have finally defeated them, and they have fully surrendered to us. We have realized the dream of the late Sultan Suleyman I, and have brought glory to our nation. Now the time has come to consolidate our new lands, and ensure that they stay belonging to us.

Despite the valiant attempt of our army and the young Sultan Osman II, we have sadly been defeated by the Greeks. A stain on our young Sultans reign, and a disgrace to the legacy of his father Suleyman I. While all is not yet lost, we must consider why it was that we lost the war, and prepare ourselves for the future. The Sultanate of Rum will not go quietly into the night!

For 5 years now we have been in a state of war with Cappadocia, and this is only a small part of a long history of conflict between our two nations. The famine and devestation they experienced 10 years ago has them weak, and ill prepared for our might. We could finally seize all of Anatolia, with the might of our armies and shrewd mind of our great Sultan. This is the start of a new age, the age of Rum!

The City of Constantinople has defied our demands! They have responded that they would sooner die than let themselves be ruled by "some cutthroat Turkic mongrel." They dishonor themselves with their words and actions, we tried to avoid further bloodshed in a conflict that has already been decided. Alas, we are left with no choice.

The Queen of Cities, the Heart of the Empire, the City of the World's Desires, Constantinople, has surrendered to us. Today our troops marched into the city, proudly waving the banner of Rum. The Kingdom of the Greeks has finally been defeated, and we can now claim their prized possesion.

Yesterday the world grew silent. The Queen of Cities and City of the World's Desires, Constantinople, fell to Turkic forces. The blue and white banner of Rum now flies above the Hagia Sofia. Anatolian and Levantine troops patrol the street, and the Hagia Sofia has been closed for the foreseeable future. Today is a dark day in the history of Greece, and marks the dawn of a new era.

The Albanian people have risen up in rebellion against the Bulgar state. They have declared a popular Albanian general as king, and have sent us a request for aid. They propose a strong relationship and a partition of Macedonia. What should we do?

The Albanian revolution is triumphant! With our help they have won, and the Bulgar state has been forced to recognize their independence. However, this independence will always be under threat from other powers in the region. That is why we must ensure their continued existence by forming a closer relationship between our two states, we will gain their loyalty in return for protecting them with our armies.

At 9 PM yesterday, the nation received tragic news. Sultan Osman II passed away, surrounded by his family, close friends, and most loyal of ministers. The Sultan was hard at work until his last moment, coordinating policies with his ministers and discussing tax reforms. No matter what one thinks of the late Sultan, he was undeniably a man commited to his country. His son and heir, Sultan Mehmed the Fourth, will be crowned in the days to come. It is hard to say what the young sultan will accomplish during his reign, but his fathers legacy will surely weigh hard on his every action.

With our recent conquests our nation has grown large than any previous sultan could even dream of. That has led to some of our ministers proposing a new capital for our Empire. The most loyal ministers all agree that Constantinople would be a great fit, being the former heart of Cappadocia and a city unrivaled in beauty or fame. The Anatolian nobles are pushing for Ankara, a large city in central Anatolia, as the Anatolians make up a significant part of our population. The Turkic nobles are all in favor of keeping the capital in Antioch, if it has worked as a capital for hundreds of years it will surely work for a hundred more.

The Caliph of Mecca has sent us an emissary to proclaim his great displeasure with our recent actions. He says we are straying from the hadiths, and demands that we travel to Mecca and acknowledge him as our superior. This is outrageous, our sublime nation has done more for Islam than anyone since Saladin walked this earth! However, some of our ministers are worried that openly disobeying the Caliph could invite conflict that we are not ready for. It is up to our glorious Sultan Osman II to make a decision, and we know he will of course make the correct one.
The Conquest of Central Anatolia
Despite our best efforts we were defeated by the Cappadocians in the war for Anatolia. We have learnt from our mistake and adapted, this time we will not lose, Anatolia will be ours!
Kick the Greeks out of Anatolia
The time has come for our final war for Anatolia. We have the momentum to finally accomplish the dreams of Mehmed I and take control over all of Anatolia.
Claim the Queen of Cities

Now that all of Anatolia has been liberated, there is but one prize left to claim: The City of the World's Desire. The Greeks still cling to Constantinople, a potential staging ground for a revanchist invasion to reclaim their lost lands. We can demand the surrender of the city, if they refuse we could always back down but it would hurt our international prestige.
The Road to Europe

§GThis decision will unlock some minor extra expansion in Europe.§!While we do not neccesarily envision large annexations in Europe, prefering to focus on the middle east, we could seek to make some minor territorial adjustments to better protect our holdings on the continent.
The Bulgarian Conquest

The major threat to our control over Constantinople is the Bulgarian region, he who controlls it will have an easy path towards the city. Taking over the lands ourselves would give us a nice buffer between Constantinople and potential enemies in the Balkans.
Dealing with the remaining threat

Armenia has always been closely allied to the Christian and Roman states that occupied much of the Middle East. An alliance between them and the Greeks could prove fatal for us, so we need to take proactive measures to kill the threat in its cradle. We will use the Kurdish people as cover, claiming that the Armenians mistreat them for their beliefs, and invade them.
Bringing all of Armenia under our heel
While our initial annexations have proved a success, Armenia still remains as an independent state. We will redo our previous diplomatic play, but this time under the banner of Azerbaijani rights.
The Assyrian Province

The Assyrians have recently, much like us, declared their desire for independence from the Persian Empire. This gives us the chance to come in as champions of minority rights, and offering them protection and status within our Empire in return for their cooperation.
Expanding our Mediterranean Influence

The Islands of Cyprus and Crete are usefull naval bases for trade within the Mediterranean, claiming them for ourselves and annexing them would further cement our position as the dominant power in the region.
March on Jerusalem

The city of Jerusalem has often changed hands throughout history. At one point it was ruled by Rome, then it was ruled by the Caliph of Mecca, then the crusaders took over and then it returned to the hands of the Caliph. However, after The Uprising of 1811 Egypt controlled it to ensure continued stability in the third holiest city. Both they and the Rashidun have shown themselves to be unfit rulers of the city, giving us a just cause to claim it for ourselves.
The Holy City

The Caliph of Mecca refuses to change with the times. The age of religion has long passed, and the age of empires has come to take its place. The Caliph is a fool to not realize this, and such a man cannot be allowed to control the most important city in our faith.
The Egyptian Counter Coup

The Egyptian state has recently been couped by nobles dissatisfied with the actions taken by their king. We could march into their nation under the cause of restoring the king, and once they have been defeated we can replace their current corrupt government with our own corrupt and loyal government, ensuring stability in the nation.
Declare the Birth of the Seljuk Empire

Now that all our external enemies have been brought down we can declare the formation of a new empire, a Seljuk Empire. This would allow us to use the title of Emperor instead of being a mere sultan, granting us the status and authority we deserve. We have finally accomplished Mehmed's dream, the Turks rule the Orient!
Claim the position of Caliph

Mecca is under our control, and the Rashidun Caliphate have shown themselves incapable of stopping us. To ensure continued stability in our vast empire, and the loyalty of our many new subjects, we will raise ourselves to not just be Emperors, but Caliphs aswell. Unlike the many false Caliphs we will not rule over a Caliphate, we will still be an Empire.
The Konya Decree

Our Empire is massive, consisting of many people. Many of these individuals still have loyalties towards foreign states, and that is an internal risk we cannot allow to exist. We will establish several laws and reforms to gently encourage certain groups to shed their old identities for a new, more unified one.
Establish a National Education Standard

The Education system in our nation is an old and conservative institution. Many people are locked out of societal advancement due to being illiterate, and learning how to read is generally only a possibility for those who come from rich families. We need competent administrators, no matter what their last name is, and to ensure that we gain these people we need to reform the school system to be more inclusive.
Establish a Ministry of Land Reform

Land reform is an important issue in our nation. Many areas are still predominantly owned by aristocrats and the state. By creating a ministry tasked with the issue we can ensure that our people will have more independence from the upper classes, giving us an economic boost aswell as a grateful population.
Embrace the Industrial Age

The dawn of a new age has come, the Industrial Age. While our nation has not rejected industrialization, it has not neccesarily encouraged it. This will change as of today. If we wish to compete with the Great Powers of the world we need to establish a stable and functional economy in our nation, aided by new innovations.
A National Culture

In the age of nationalism it is important that we ensure there are unified cultural aspects that all our people share. They must see themselves as part of one people, rather than many small groups that are part of the same Empire. Osman II is a known appreciator of the arts, and he particularly enjoyed many of the art pieces and theater shows he visited during his years in Europe. Bringing them over will allow us to bring our nation closer together.
Increase Military Standards

The army has served us well for many years, but new innovations and ideas are always showing up. We cannot allow our army to stagnate, we need to increase our standards and ensure that we do not let the Europeans gain a lasting technological advantage.
Forming a Modern Navy

The Sultanate of Rum has never been in a position that demands a mighty navy, and thus we have ignored it in favor of a strong army. After our recent rise in status it has however become pertinent for us to to change this. To protect merchants from our country, and guard the nation from external threats, a modern navy is a requirement.
Ensuring Military Superiority

The many enemies of our nation are all eagerly looking for any opportunity to bring us down. We need to make sure that our people can rest easy at night by having an army strong and large enough to defeat any potential invader. §RTo do this decision you need to have a larger army than: The Greek Nation, Venice/Italy, Aragon/Aragon-Italy, Hungary, and Rashidun Caliphate.§!
The End of the Standing Army

The army has served us well since the birth of our nation, but our enemis have adapted. Many European states have adopted the policy of mobilisation, drafting civilians into the army in times of war. This gives them a substantial manpower advantage, an advantage that could prove fatal for us. We will adapt to the times and adopt this new idea.
The Capital of our Empire
With our recent conquests the idea of possible declaring a new capital to mark this new era in our history has been raised.
